PLAN1 · layout v3 · 🟡 Active. JSON files are the source of truth; the Markdown files in this directory are generated views — never edit them.

## Carriers

| Carrier | Holds |
|:--|:--|
| `plan.json` | identity, goal, rules, phase order, settings |
| `brief.json` | owner messages and requirements |
| `phases/<Pn>/phase.json` | phase context, scope, batches, validation |
| `phases/<Pn>/<Pn.m>.json` | one item: stable spec and volatile result |
| `decisions/<D#>.json` | decisions and open questions |
| `log.jsonl` | append-only events |
| `plan.md` `roadmap.md` `status.md` `handoff.md` `open-questions.md` | generated views |

## Change the plan

Use `python3 <task>/scripts/plan.py`: `next`, `show`, `set`, `push`, `add-phase`, `add-item`, `add-decision`, `batches`, `check`, `render`. Hand edits of JSON are repaired by `plan.py check` and `plan.py render`.
